title_sq: Triplex (me pishine) ne shitje tek Swan Lake Residence, Buze Liqenit te Farkes ID D8143A5
description_sq:
Tek Swan Lake Residence, nje nga redidencat me elitare buze Liqenit te Farkes, Disponojme per shitje Triplex 3+1 +3 tualete + Verande dhe Pishine me siperfaqe totale 210.83 m², nga te cilat:
Siperfaqe fizike: 206.69 m²
Siperfaqe e perbashket 4.14 m²
Projekti eshte ne faze ndertimi - parashikohet qe afati i perfundimit eshte fundi i veres 2026.
Trilexi zhvillohet ne 3 kate funksionale + Pishine ne Tarace,
Kati i pare organizohet ne sallon se bashku me kuzhinen, 1 tualet dhe verande,
Kati i dyte ne 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet dhe ballkon,
Kati i trete ne 1 dhome gjumi te bollshme, 1 tualet dhe ballkon dhe ne katin e fundit pishina
(per me shume detaje, shikoni planimetrine tek fotot)
Swan Lake Residence eshte nje rezidence elitare, e cila nderthur ne menyre harmonike natyren me dizajnin elegant, duke ofruar nje pervoje jetese te qete dhe te rafinuar.
E projektuar per te rritur cilesine e jeteses, Rezidenca Swan Lake do te ofroje gjithashtu sherbime te integruara, duke siguruar rehati, komoditet dhe nje stil jetese te orientuar drejt mireqenies dhe luksit te perditshem.
Triplexi disponon dokumentacion te rregullt nga firma e ndertimit.
Ofrohen dhe poste parkimi ne shitje me cmim ekstra, nga 25 000€ - 30 000 €
(ne varesi te m² dhe pozicionimit te postit te parkimit)
Cmimi: 390 000 euro
(cmim me i ulet sesa tek ndertuesi)
Per me shume informacion ose per nje vizite ne prone, mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni!
title_en: Triplex (with swimming pool) for sale at Swan Lake Residence, Farke Lakeside ID D8143A5
description_en: At Swan Lake Residence, one of the most elite residences on the edge of Lake Farka, we have for sale Triplex 3+1 + 3 bathrooms + Verandah and Pool with a total area of 210.83 m², of which: Physical area: 206.69 m² Total area 4.14 m² The project is under construction - the completion date is expected to be the end of summer 2026. Trilex is developed in 3 functional floors + Swimming pool on the Terrace, the first floor is organized in the living room together with the kitchen, 1 toilet and veranda, the second floor in 2 bedrooms, 1 toilet and balcony, the third floor in 1 spacious bedroom, 1 toilet and balcony and on the top floor the swimming pool (for more details, see the floor plan in the photos) Swan Lake Residence is an elite residence, which combines harmoniously nature with elegant design, offering a quiet and refined living experience. Designed to enhance the quality of life, the Swan Lake Residence will also offer integrated services, ensuring comfort, convenience and a lifestyle oriented towards well-being and everyday luxury. Triplex has regular documentation from the construction company. Parking stalls are also available for sale at an extra price, from €25,000 - €30,000 (depending on the m² and positioning of the parking stall) Price: 390,000 euros (lower price than the builder) For more information or for a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
